items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: They were in Slide Hampton’s band together.

ctx.x: They were in Slide Hampton’s band together. And he said man Freddie was about 18 man, just blowing all kinds of stuff. But when he got around 24, 25 years old, he really came into his own and just was young enough with the energy to do what he wanted to do, and had a few years under his belt that he could be a little more predictable, bluesy and with a little more heart.
If you had to make a short list of trumpet players that every aspiring student should listen to, and really listen to, who would they be?
